title: New non-quadratic Euclidean complete affine maximal type hypersurfaces via Calabi affine geometry
summary: The Bernstein problem for the affine maximal type equation \[ \sum_{i,j=1}^n f^{ij} w_{ij}=0,\qquad w\equiv \left[\det\left(\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x_i\partial x_j}\right)\right]^a,\quad x\inΩ\subset\mathbb R^n, \] is a central problem in affine geometry. It originates from Chern's conjecture on entire locally convex graphs for the case $n=2$ and $a=-\frac{3}{4}$ in 1977. This conjecture was completely resolved by Trudinger and Wang in 2000, who moreover proposed a generalization to arbitrary dimension $n\ge2$ for $a=-\frac{n+1}{n+2}$ under the assumption of Euclidean completeness.…
